author: reek
body: The divisor is a literal at each division site because the strength reduction only fires on a literal, and the dividend arrives as a parameter because a constant dividend folds at compile time and would measure the folder instead of the emitter.

author: reek
body: The general path is measured beside the power-of-two path in every row. Both columns must read the same rule; that they did not is the whole defect.

author: reek
body: `int-mod` is Euclidean -- always non-negative, whatever the signs -- and that is a separate contract from division's. It is measured here so a change to the division path that disturbed it would be visible.
